shortDescription: Polish parcel locker operator InPost EURONEXT:INPST said on Friday that 89.81% of its shares had been tendered in the offer from a consortium made up of FedEx NYSE:FDX, Advent International and other investors.The minimum acceptance threshold of 80% of shares was reached, InPost added.
